items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: And David Letterman goes, “And our first guest tonight is one of the Baldwin brothers.”

ctx.x: No one wrote out a chart in other words.

No. Well sometimes we had charts. Sometimes we did. And then we’d do okay what was the top ten list. The top ten list has something to do with balloons. Okay we’ll do “99 Luftballoons” by that German band. Okay we got that. And then we got “Rockin’ Robin” © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

for Robin Williams. Okay. And then you go and you do the rehearsal and it’s like seven minutes and then the comedy does their rehearsal and then the feature band that’s on they do their rehearsal. Then they load the audience in and the comic comes on so it’s about an hour and a half, maybe two hours from the time you had your seven minute rehearsal to the show.
